site.title: Geo-tools
site.byline: Free geoscience apps and games by Dougalien Systems

tools.name: Lithonaut
tools.summary: A 3D rock cycle game. Visit field sites, take hand samples, and identify igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks.

tools.name: Solar System Adventure
tools.summary: Fly with PEBBLES, the ship computer, to 21 worlds and judge whether each one has the ingredients for life.

tools.name: The Rock Cycle
tools.summary: Explore how rocks change from one type to another, with a gallery of real lab samples.

tools.name: Quake
tools.summary: Explore recent earthquakes from USGS data with a guided earthquake science mentor.

tools.name: River Explorer
tools.summary: Type a river, a town or a storm you remember. Find the real USGS stream gage and read its hydrograph.

tools.name: Resource Horizon
tools.summary: Will a resource last 100 years? Compare flat, steady and compounding use, with a source for every number.

tools.name: Hydrotherm
tools.summary: Compare data center cooling water with climate-driven evapotranspiration, with every number checkable by hand.

tools.name: TraceCode
tools.summary: Analyze x-y lab signals from GC, XRD and SEM/EDS: baselines, smoothing, peaks and FFT.

tools.name: Spectrum Earth
tools.summary: Signal analysis for landforms, including volcano shapes from elevation profiles.
